title: Near-horizon soft theorems from local Ward identities
summary: We develop a unified formulation of leading soft photon theorems for nondegenerate static spherical horizons. By fixing the photon mode normalization from the horizon symplectic form, we obtain a common angular soft factor whose sign follows from the boundary orientation. We determine the geometric coefficients in the local angular and momentum representations for a chosen radial normalization.
